HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 6533/2019 Banwari Lal Gupta S/o Shri Bajrang Lal Gupta and anr.
 ----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan through PP  ----Respondent Connected With S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 6531/2019 Banwari Lal Gupta S/o Shri Bajrang Lal Gupta ----Petitioner Versus State Of Rajasthan through PP ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mayank Gupta For Respondent(s) : Mr. Ganesh Saini, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SATISH KUMAR SHARMA Order 08/07/2021 S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 6533/2019 Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the alleged offence was committed after repeal of the PFA Act, 1954, therefore, the proceedings initiated upon the complaint filed under the PFA Act, 1954 cannot be continued and deserve to be quashed.
During the course of arguments, learned counsel for the petitioners was asked to address on the issue whether the offence in question was committed at the time when the new Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 was in force and as to whether the trial can be continued in new act instead of PFA Act, 1954.
